Grace / Hannah — adding more color on the three Eng folks you called out. I'm pasting sanitized manager notes below (keeps identifying details minimal):

On Fri, 2026-03-05 at 09:12, Grace O'Connor wrote:
> I am particularly concerned about three ICs on Eng (see rows 3, 7, 9). Comments indicate burnout + manager mismatch.

- Employee A (row 3): reported "no visible growth plan" and declined optional 1:1 last month. Manager has tried skip-level; suggested action is immediate career conversation + 30/60 plan. Manager suspects travel/flex constraints adding to stress.
- Employee B (row 7): performance decline y/y and several late deliverables; manager is preparing a formal PIP draft but is open to an aligned coaching plan instead. This looks like performance + engagement.
- Employee C (row 9): verbalized intent to explore other offers during an exit-sounding comment. Manager booked an exploratory 1:1 next week but asked for HR presence.

Given the mix (burnout, performance, potential exit), I recommend managers run the template and set a short follow-up with Talent Partner present where appropriate. For Employee B, if the PIP proceeds we should speak to Legal first.
